prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: unique supporting artwork for ONE Indonesian small-business Instagram carousel, portrait 4:5. Brand context: Loka Kasir. Render the SPECIFIC scene below, with large clear subjects and a purposeful camera view. Upper 25–30 percent should be visually quiet so the separately typeset headline can be placed there; stage the actual objects and people prominently in the remaining area. The scene must carry the story; never substitute generic abstract cards, charts, floating app UI, or an anonymous cashier portrait. Cobalt-blue details connect the brand while other scene colors remain natural. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, readable receipts, signage, A/B/C graphics, infographic panels, price typography, or actual app screenshots. Unbranded screens and tags remain blank. Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.
Style: Natural editorial photography with believable Indonesian small-business detail, tactile materials, realistic hands and skin, purposeful camera framing, no stock-photo posing.
Color direction: navy, warm amber, paper ivory.
Specific scene: Documentary photo of a small shop owner closing the month at a dining table: several different blank-facing purchase receipts arranged into three tidy groups, a cup of tea, a nearly finished notebook, warm desk lamp. Hands do the sorting, owner's face only partly visible at the frame edge. Quiet concentrated late-night atmosphere.
